def setHtml(self, column, html):
        """
        Creates a label with the given HTML for this item and column.  This
        method requires the item to be a part of the tree.

        :param      column | <int>
                    html   | <unicode>

        :return     <bool> | success
        """
        return self.tree.setHtml(self.id, column, html)
